summary: Lennar Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting the October 15, 2026 settlement of a $600 million registered debt offering: $300 million of 5.700% senior notes due 2029 and $300 million of 5.950% senior notes due 2032, guaranteed by certain wholly owned subsidiaries. Underwriters, represented by BBVA, BofA, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, Truist and Wells Fargo, priced the deal October 13, 2026 under an existing Form S-3 shelf. Proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, including possible debt repayment, land spend or working capital. This is a routine capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; watch for rate-driven spread moves and any follow-on issuance given the homebuilder's liquidity profile.
